pr_title: Adjust "recent projects" modal behavior to allow opening projects in both current and new window
pr_body:
![image](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/2690773/7a0927e8-f32a-4502-8a8a-c7f8e5f325bb)

Fixes https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/7419 by changing the way "recent projects" modal confirm actions work:
* `menu::Confirm` now reuses the current window when opening a recent project
* `menu::SecondaryConfirm` now opens a recent project in the new window 
* neither confirm tries to open the current project anymore
* modal's placeholder is adjusted to emphasize this behavior

Release Notes:

- Added a way to open recent projects in the new window
pr_comments: Thank you! Can't wait to see this feature in action! 🎉

issue_context.title: Before opening a new project, allow user to choose between "Open in a new window" and "Open in current window"
issue_context.body: ### Check for existing issues - [X] Completed ### Describe the feature User Story: As a... low-spec computer user I want to... choose between "Open in a new window" and "Open in current window" when opening a new project in Zed, with a "Remember my choice (can be changed from settings)" checkbox So that... I can switch projects without having to worry about memory consumption ### If applicable, add mockups / screenshots to help present your vision of the feature Zed's memory consumption when 1 window (1 project) is open: Zed's memory consumption when 3 windows (3 projects) are open:
comments:
Like that!, but I would go further and have a project switcher. Today, there's an option to "Open recently projects" what show me the option to jump to another project super easily (in another window), but is limited to the last projects already opened.

If we could specify somehow the projects' folder(s) [~/projects, ~/study], and each folder be shown in the new Project Switcher, that would be fantastic. I'm saying that because I believe that zed is the only possible editor that could do that fast, since the load time of a project is instantaneously.

The only problem of working with multiple projects, and multiple windows is of course memory as already mentioned by @tanmaymishu, but also the only way to easily navigate through windows is by using native window managers. 

Tell me if this should become a new issue or as believe it is related to this one, peace!

review_comments: I don't know how feasible that is, but it would be incredible to show the actual bindings here :)

It is a bit complicated due to the fact that we allow to do cmd-click there: https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/176f11bdc0e5acfc8d60a05aa95580ddfbdcb817/crates/picker/src/picker.rs#L316

which has its own problems with Linux already, and due to the fact that the input is just too small to fit everything (spent ~10 mins wording that text to make it fit, and it still does not for my font...).

So, decided to be on  a safe side for now.
